name: drawio-slides
description: A fork of the Draw.io Integration of Henning Dieterichs, for slide decks drawn in draw.io.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace settings cannot load custom libraries or plugins, or change which Draw.io app the editor loads.

commands.title: Link Workspace Symbol With Selected Node

drawioSlides.offline.title: Use Offline Mode
drawioSlides.offline.description: When enabled, the bundled instance of Draw.io is used.

drawioSlides.online-url.title: Online URL
drawioSlides.online-url.description: The app to use when offline mode is disabled.

drawioSlides.codeLinkActivated.title: Code Link Enabled
drawioSlides.codeLinkActivated.description: When activated, selecting a node will navigate to an associated code section.

drawioSlides.local-storage.title: Draw.io Local Storage
drawioSlides.local-storage.description: Only change this property if you know what you are doing. Manual changes to this property are not supported!

drawioSlides.simpleLabels.title: Use SimpleLabels
drawioSlides.simpleLabels.description: When enabled, no ForeignObjects are used in the svg.

drawioSlides.svgAppearance.title: SVG Appearance
drawioSlides.svgAppearance.description: The appearance of `.drawio.svg` files and SVG exports. It does not depend on the theme of the editor.

drawioSlides.zoomFactor.title: Draw.io zoom factor
drawioSlides.zoomFactor.description: Defines the zoom factor for mouse wheel and trackpad zoom.

drawioSlides.globalVars.title: Draw.io global variables.
drawioSlides.globalVars.description: Defines global variables for system-wide placeholders using a JSON structure with key, value pairs. Keep the number of global variables small.

drawioSlides.resizeImages.title: Draw.io resize images.
drawioSlides.resizeImages.description: If set to true, images are resized automatically on paste. If not defined, the user will be asked to confirm the resize.

drawioSlides.showTooltipIcons.title: Show Tooltip Icons
drawioSlides.showTooltipIcons.description: Specifies whether tooltip icons are shown.

drawioSlides.showLinkIcons.title: Show Link Icons
drawioSlides.showLinkIcons.description: Specifies whether link icons are shown.

drawioSlides.showConnectHandle.title: Show Connect Handle
drawioSlides.showConnectHandle.description: Specifies whether the connect handle is shown on selected vertices.

drawioSlides.inlineEditor.minimalUI.description: Use minimal draw.io UI (hides sidebar, format panel, scrollbars)

drawioSlides.inlineEditor.diagramPadding.description: Padding (in pixels) around diagram content in the viewer and inline editor. Must be large enough to show selection handles (typically 20px).

drawioSlides.slides.description: Treat the drawings as slides of the draw.io presentation framework: load its plugins, which play the videos and pages of the cells, style the lists and check the language, and draw the pictures of the deck folder.

drawioSlides.listStyles.description: The style of each level of a bulleted and of a numbered list that the list buttons of draw.io make, and the gap above each item but the first of a first level. A level deeper than the lists give takes the last style. The build of the draw.io presentation framework reads the same setting.

indent.description: The left padding of the list, as CSS, such as `26.07px`.

marker.description: The `list-style-type` of the list, such as `disclosure-closed` or `'-  '`.

color.description: The colour of the marker, as CSS.

size.description: The size of the marker, as CSS, such as `0.7em`.

indent.description: The left padding of the list, as CSS, such as `26.07px`.

marker.description: The `list-style-type` of the list, such as `disclosure-closed` or `'-  '`.

color.description: The colour of the marker, as CSS.

size.description: The size of the marker, as CSS, such as `0.7em`.

drawioSlides.listMarkers.description: The markers of the menu List style, each as its `list-style-type` and its name. The marker `template` gives a list the style of its level again.

drawioSlides.templates.description: The template files of a deck, multi-page draw.io files whose pages are the layouts of its slides, each named by its layout. The menus Insert and Pages of the editor offer Insert slide, which inserts a copy of a layout after the current page. The last part of a path may hold `*`, and a path may hold `${deckFolder}`, the nearest folder above the drawing with a `package.json`, and `${workspaceFolder}`. A relative path is read from the deck folder.

drawioSlides.slideSize.description: The size of a slide. The page view keeps a page of this size at one page, as the build cuts each slide at the edge of its page.

drawioSlides.languageTool.description: The address of the LanguageTool server that checks the spelling and the grammar of the label being edited. The check of every slide of the draw.io presentation framework, `npm run check`, reads the same setting.

drawioSlides.colorDefinitions.description: TeX files of `\definecolor` lines, in the models rgb, RGB, gray, Gray, cmy, cmyk or HTML. The editor and the build of the draw.io presentation framework convert the models alike and give MathJax each colour in the model RGB. The editor defines the colours for the formulas of every page and names them in the colour picker, and the build writes them into each page that uses them. A path may hold `${deckFolder}`, the nearest folder above the drawing with a `package.json`, and `${workspaceFolder}`. A relative path is read from the deck folder.

file.description: The file path to the library. Must be absolute. You can use `${workspaceFolder}`.

drawioSlides.plugins.title: Plugins
drawioSlides.plugins.markdownDescription: Loads Draw.io plugins from the local filesystem.  See description of the `file` property. See [plugins documentation](https://github.com/hediet/vscode-drawio/blob/master/docs/plugins.md).

drawioSlides.knownPlugins.title: Known Plugins
drawioSlides.knownPlugins.markdownDescription: List of allowed or denied plugins. The extension will read and write to this list based on what the used decides when loading specific plugins. See [plugins documentation](https://github.com/hediet/vscode-drawio/blob/master/docs/plugins.md).

entryId.description: The id of the entry. A specfic entry can be enabled or deactivated in the editor.

libName.description: The name of the library in the shape overview.

file.description: The file path to the library. Must be absolute. You can use ${workspaceFolder}.

drawioSlides.customLibraries.title: Custom Libraries
drawioSlides.customLibraries.description: Configures the Draw.io editor to use custom libraries.

drawioSlides.styles.title: Styles
drawioSlides.styles.description: Defines an array of objects that contain the colours (fontColor, fillColor, strokeColor and gradientColor) for the Style tab of the format panel if the selection is empty. These objects can have a commonStyle (which is applied to both vertices and edges), vertexStyle (applied to vertices) and edgeStyle (applied to edges), and a graph with background and gridColor. An empty object means apply the default colors

drawioSlides.colorNames.title: Color Names
drawioSlides.colorNames.description: Names for colors, eg. {‘FFFFFF’: ‘White’, ‘000000’: ‘Black’} that are used as tooltips (uppercase, no leading # for the colour codes)

drawioSlides.presetColors.title: Preset Colors
drawioSlides.presetColors.description: Color codes for the upper palette in the color dialog.

items.description: Use hex codes without # at the beginning only (FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

drawioSlides.customColorSchemes.title: Custom Color Schemes
drawioSlides.customColorSchemes.markdownDescription: Available color schemes in the style section at the top of the format panel. See example [here](https://www.diagrams.net/doc/faq/custom-colours-confluence-cloud#default-colour-schemes---format-panel)

items.description: Represents a page of color schemes.

title.description: Title of the color used in tooltips.

fill.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

stroke.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

gradient.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

font.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

drawioSlides.customFonts.title: Custom Fonts
drawioSlides.customFonts.description: Configures the Draw.io editor to use custom fonts.

drawioSlides.theme.title: Draw.io Theme
drawioSlides.theme.description: The theme to use for the Draw.io editor. Use "automatic" to automatically choose a Draw.io theme that matches your current VS Code theme.

drawioSlides.appearance.title: Draw.io Appearance
drawioSlides.appearance.description: The appearance to use for the Draw.io editor. Use "automatic" to automatically choose a Draw.io theme that matches your current VS Code theme.

scripts.build: yarn build-extension && yarn build-plugins && yarn package-extension
